task: Make source code viewable from the Workspace Monitor / installable platform interface.

expected_items.description: The monitor must expose repository source code so the user can inspect implementation files.
Source visibility must stay read-only and must not imply browser-based editing or saving.
Source code visibility must be limited to developer and superadmin developer views, not the ordinary user view.
The source collector must use a narrow allowlist and skip generated snapshots, build outputs, dependencies, and large files.
The installable desktop platform user flow must mention source code browsing for developer/superadmin usage.
Implement in-browser editing, saving, diffing, or IDE-like code actions.
expected_items.rationale: The request was to make source code viewable. Editing is intentionally outside this change because it would add write risk and permission design.

expected_items.description: Install Monaco or Shiki for richer code rendering.
expected_items.rationale: A dependency-free read-only viewer is sufficient for the current requirement. Rich highlighting can be reconsidered when the viewer becomes a deeper code inspection tool.

artifact_checks.purpose: Collect source files into the Workspace Monitor snapshot.
Render the Source section, filters, file list, and read-only source viewer.
Define which view modes can access the source section.

acceptance_checks.description: Collector tests confirm sourceFiles are collected and generated snapshots are skipped.
Workspace Monitor snapshot, type check, and static build pass with the Source section.
View mode registry validates after adding the source section.
Generated snapshot contains sourceFiles and exposes source only in developer/superadmin views.

known_omission_risks: Public deployment must review whether sourceFiles should be removed, restricted, or generated only for private/admin builds.
Browser screenshot verification was not run because the Browser tool was unavailable in this session and Playwright was not installed in the project.
notes: The source viewer is intentionally dependency-free and read-only.
